# S4.11 — MCP server: lab read/launch/experiment/results groups (C1 `hh-lab/1`)

- **Ticket:** `docs/tickets/073_S4.11__mcp-server-lab-groups.md`
- **Branch:** `svitali/harnessharness-s4.11` (stacked on `svitali/harnessharness-s4.10` @ `1c382f4`)
- **Requirement:** R-2.11.3¹ — §7.3 MCP-server surface group — `met_differently`
- **Closes:** R-2.11.3¹ (AC-R-2.11.3-{3–5,7–9,12–13}); refines AC-6's budget gate per the ADR-0183-era audit partition
- **ADR:** `docs/adr/ADR-0303-s4.11-mcp-lab-surface-rulings.md`
- **Deferrals opened:** DF-S4.11-1 (Streamable-HTTP SSE half), DF-S4.11-2 (H3 credential mediator), DF-S4.11-3 (surface-run Π-ask reply path)
- **Deferrals closed:** none. DF-S4.10-1 (HUMAN-H1, the E3 surface binding) stays **gate pending** — an operator gate, not a code state; the proxy `hh-embed-client-generated::NetClient` carries the real transport meanwhile.

## What landed

**New crate `crates/hh-mcp-lab`** — the C1 `hh-lab/1` MCP server slice
over both declared transports, one dispatch chain:

- `server.rs` — line-delimited JSON-RPC (stdio); `initialize` →
  `protocolVersion` `2025-11-25`, `initialize_result`
  (`serverInfo{name, version, protocol_version, tool_version_id}`,
  capability entries per tool `{call_kind, permission_policy,
  idempotent, zone_class}`). The metadata surface runs free.
- `http.rs` — Streamable HTTP: `POST /mcp`, one JSON-RPC frame per
  request; `Mcp-Session-Id` issued on `initialize`, `404` on stale,
  `400` when required-but-absent; `OriginPolicy` → `403`; bearer grant
  → `401` + `WWW-Authenticate`; `202` on notifications; `405` on the
  non-POST legs (SSE downgrade → DF-S4.11-1).
- `binding.rs` — `CallerBinding`, `CallerKind` (`human_principal`,
  `agent`, `provider_client`, `service`), `CallerCredential`
  (`stdio_launch`, `bearer`, `oauth`, `mtls`), `BindingTable`,
  `CallerAuth` (stdio_launch + bearer-table; the H3 mediator →
  DF-S4.11-2).
- `session.rs` — `SurfaceSession` = the connection's durable state:
  `run_kind = surface`, binding/scheme/hash cells in `extra`, pool-root
  `control.budget.allocated` at open, lazy mint, restart rebind by
  manifest scan + writer-lease re-acquire. `kind`/`version`/`hash` are
  projected from the manifest — never stored duplicate (single source).
  The agents turn/effect/`budget.consumed` machinery shared by every
  surface call.
- `effects.rs` — the Rule-C-compliant effect chain (intended →
  authorized (+ `permission.decided` on the mutating leg) → prepared →
  committed | observed | refused), declared-members-only payloads.
- `launch.rs` — `launch_run` (budget gate → committed write-ahead →
  `open_session{OpenSpec{spawn_event}}` → `hnd-run-*` mint → observed),
  `cancel_run`, `submit_input`, `respond_approval` (human-kind gate,
  `IllegitimateEndorsement` with the durable refused row).
- `reads.rs` — `read_ledger`/`run_status`/`get_trace`/
  `list_pending_approvals` under `ExposurePolicy`; withheld rows
  listed; `measurement.export.delivered` minted on the READ run.
- `experiment.rs` group verbs (`dispatch.rs`) — `open_experiment`
  routes to `hh-embed`'s `open_session{ExperimentSpec}`; `run_exit`,
  `pause`, `send_input` round the group.
- `results.rs` group — `get_experiment_report`, `get_matrix`,
  `export_run` (policy-filtered, delivered-minted like the read arm).
- `supply.rs` — binding-supplied surfaces: `callable ⇔ revealed`,
  `hidden` ↔ `unknown_tool`, Π `deny` → refused; `ask` → durable
  `security.permission.pending` + `PermissionAskRequired`
  (reply path → DF-S4.11-3); `allow` → the declared stub executor.
- `handles.rs` — `hnd-<kind>-<idp>` mints persisted as
  `lifecycle.surface.call.minted`; owner-scoped resolution; `UnknownHandle` /
  `NoCoveringGrant` / `HandleExpired` typed refusals.
- `exposure.rs` — the `hh-lab/1` exposure document (data, not code):
  tools + `served`/`policy`/`budget_scopes`/`supply_surfaces`/
  `caller_bindings`/`losses`; `parse → link → lower` produces the
  `ServedArtifact`; assumption-debt carriers enforced at link.

**`hh-embed-schema`** — `OpenSpec::New` gains `spawn_event:
SpawnEventRef{run_id, event_id}` (additive; serde-compatible — the
generated client's `new_session` row gains the nullable member);
`hh-embed` plumbs it into `manifest.spawn_event` (validated by
`open_run`'s EventRef resolver — a dangling ref refuses).
**`hh-embed`** — the `surface_*` write seam
(`surface_open_run/acquire_writer/append/commit_row/events/
manifest/run_ids/head_event_id/account/inject_durability_faults/
alloc_id/now_ms/ts_now`) — the surface's only ledger path.
**`hh-ledger`** — `classes.rs` re-export needed by the seam's
payload-builder (no class/partition changes).

## Invariants verified (AC map)

| AC | Test (`tests/s4_11.rs`) | What it proves |
|----|------------------------|----------------|
| 3 | `ac3_respond_approval_caller_kind_gate` | non-human binding → `IllegitimateEndorsement` *with* durable `refused{IllegitimateEndorsement}` |
| 4 | `ac4_missing_and_insufficient_budget` | `MissingBudget`/`InsufficientBudget{dimension, requested, available, budget_id}` before `open_session`; undeclared-dim request refuses (no silent skip); no `environment.*` rows minted |
| 5 | `ac5_per_turn_instrument_charges` | one `control.budget.consumed{tool_calls:+1, charged_to:instrument}` per turn, idempotent under rebind |
| 7/8 | `ac4_ac8_launch_spawn_event_and_resume` | launch → `hnd-run` + observed committed; `manifest.spawn_event == {surface run, committed-ref}`; restart rebinds the *same* run id; cancel → `requested → accepted` terminal |
| 9 | `ac9_supply_surface_pi` | Π `deny` → refused/never executed; `ask` → `pending` row + `PermissionAskRequired`; `allow` → declared stub executor; hidden tool → `unknown_tool` |
| 12 | `ac12_assumption_debt_required_at_link` | exposure doc missing `caller_binding.mtls` / `tasks_carrier` refuses `link`; complete doc lowers to a `ServedArtifact` |
| 13 | `ac13_every_tool_wraps_a_real_op_or_declared_lowering` | every tool `op` + declared `lowering.class`; the `tools/list` projection is byte-identical stdio ↔ HTTP |
| transports | `ac11_stdio_loop`, `ac11_http_transport` | nd-JSON-RPC loop (`-32700`, notification-no-response, EOF); `/mcp` session/401/404/405 legs |
| handles | `handle_is_a_name_not_a_capability` | mint → resolve owner-scope; foreign mint confers nothing; `UnknownHandle`/`HandleExpired` typed |
| reads | `ac7_read_ledger_policy_fold_and_delivered` | `ExposurePolicy` fold + withheld rows listed + `measurement.export.delivered` on the read run |

## Assumption debt / stubs declared

- Streamable-HTTP SSE half — DF-S4.11-1.
- H3 `CallerAuth` (oauth/mtls resolution) — DF-S4.11-2; credential
  shapes + `caller_binding.{oauth,mtls}` debt carriers land now.
- Surface-run `respond_permission` (answering a Π-ask pending row) —
  DF-S4.11-3.
- `caller_process`/`attestation` are the pinned `CallerProcess` +
  empty-evidence defaults (the lane decision landed in §8a.5's
  envelope schema; the lane profile is a Stage-4h.5 arm).
- The supply-surface `allow` arm executes the host's declared stub —
  the hosted lowering's semantics stay at the C1 minimum (the hosted
  artifact's own producer fills them).
